transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this planning roundtable. As you know, we have a proposed six-week peer-tutoring program for grades 6 through 8 on the table, and before I sign off on approval, I want to make sure we've thoroughly reviewed it from all angles. The draft plan currently calls for two adult supervisors, Google Classroom for session communication, student-selected tutor pairings, and paper consent forms collected before the program begins. I'd like to go around the table and hear from each of you about any concerns, suggestions, or information relevant to your area of expertise. Let's start with our teacher — what are your thoughts on the academic side of this proposal?

This means we cannot allow student-selected tutor pairings as the draft plan currently calls for. The pairings must be assigned and monitored by me as counselor to ensure these restrictions are respected. I should note that these restrictions are recorded only in confidential counseling files, so I can't share the specific student identities, but I can manage the pairing process to keep everyone safe.
